result.instructions: Tools for Libib, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List all patrons on our library account and show the ones with a frozen account."; "Add a new patron, Mary Shelley, with the email frankenstein@example.com."; "Which managers have access to our Libib account, and what role does each one have?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Libib data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run libib_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run libib_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run libib_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. libib_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: libib_list_accounts
tools.title: List accounts
tools.description: Show the Libib account behind this API key: organization name, owner, URL alias and API ID. Pro keys return one account. Libib API: GET /accounts.

tools.name: libib_list_managers
tools.title: List managers
tools.description: List every manager on the Libib account, including the owner, with each manager's role (owner, admin, manager or lender). Libib API: GET /managers.

tools.name: libib_get_manager
tools.title: Get manager
tools.description: Show one manager's name, email and role, found by the manager's email address. Libib API: GET /managers/{email}.

tools.name: libib_list_patrons
tools.title: List patrons
tools.description: List one page of patrons (50 per page) with their barcode, name, email, tags, patron ID, address and freeze status. The result gives total and pages; ask for the next page to read more. Libib API: GET /patrons?page=.

page.description: Page number (50 patrons per page, default 1).

tools.name: libib_get_patron
tools.title: Get patron
tools.description: Show one patron's full record, found by barcode or email address. Libib API: GET /patrons/{id}.

id.description: The patron's barcode or email address.

tools.name: libib_create_patron
tools.title: Create patron
tools.description: Create a new patron on the Libib account. first_name and last_name are required. Libib assigns the barcode itself. The patron password is not set here. Libib API: POST /patrons.

email.description: Patron's email. Must be unique on the account.

notification_emails.description: Up to 3 comma-separated emails for notifications.

patron_id.description: Custom ID (not required to be unique).

tools.name: libib_update_patron
tools.title: Update patron
tools.description: Change fields of one existing patron, found by barcode or email. Omit a field to leave it unchanged. An empty string removes that value from the patron. The patron password and barcode are not changed here. Libib API: PATCH /patrons/{id}.

id.description: The patron's barcode or email address.

email.description: Patron's email. Must be unique on the account.

notification_emails.description: Up to 3 comma-separated emails for notifications.

patron_id.description: Custom ID (not required to be unique).

country.description: 2-character country code. An empty string clears the country.
